svg.text: RxRx19: from the zips on gs://rxrx to the proposed store
each source level beside the store nodes it becomes; example: rxrx19a HRCE-1 Plate1, well AA02, site 2
Source: 1,949,904 PNGs in 916.0 GB of zips, read from the zips' central directories and metadata.csv.
Store: 901,990 nodes (a group and an array per site: 375,904 sites), 1,949,904 virtual references, no native chunks.
Store: Snapshot ≈ 57 MB at the measured 62.2–66.2 bytes per node, above the default snapshot cache of 500,000 nodes. Manifests: 375,904 (one per array in Icechunk 2.3), 113 MB.
open question, or the README says otherwise

text.tspan: # CC BY 4.0; read anonymously, over gs:// or https://storage.googleapis.com/rxrx/

svg.text: title: "RxRx19: Recursion's COVID-19 Cell Painting screens"
rxrx19a: 1,527,665 members; central directory 190.5 MB at byte 477,505,676,200 of 477,696,173,627
rxrx19b: 422,362 members; central directory 53.2 MB at byte 438,294,245,720 of 438,347,411,230
local header: 30 bytes + name + 28-byte extra field, then the PNG # checked on every member
title: "RxRx19a: SARS-CoV-2 infection in human renal cortical epithelial and Vero cells"
tables beside the store: sites (metadata.csv), embeddings (1024 per site) # Iceberg, keyed by site_id
stains: w1–w5 unmapped; pixel size: not stated
cell_type: "HRCE" # the same in every row of the experiment

text.tspan: # rxrx19a: HRCE-1 (26 plates), HRCE-2 (27 plates), VERO-1 (2 plates), VERO-2 (2 plates)

svg.text: well names: letters B–AE (30), numbers 02–47 (46) # the inner 30 × 46 wells of a 32 × 48 plate
rows: [A … AF], columns: [1 … 48], # all 32 × 48 of the 1536-well format
wells: [{path: "AA/10"}, … 1,340 wells]}} # rxrx19a 1340 per plate, rxrx19b 1328

text.tspan: # the README reads AA02 as "column AA, row 2"; but the letters (30) fit the plate's 32 rows and the numbers (46) its 48 columns

svg.text: channel w3 of w1–w5 (rxrx19a), w1–w6 (rxrx19b) # no file says which stain each w is
local header at 132,963,618,065; PNG at 132,963,618,166, 455,182 bytes, stored
columns: site_id, well_id, cell_type, experiment, plate, well, site, disease_condition, treatment, treatment_conc, SMILES
rxrx19a: 305,520 rows, one per site; 305,520 match a site with PNGs, 0 do not
rxrx19b: 70,384 rows, one per site; 70,384 match a site with PNGs, 0 do not
rxrx19a: conditions Active SARS-CoV-2 280,376, UV Inactivated SARS-CoV-2 9,120, Mock 9,120, (blank) 6,904
